tools.name: list_answers
tools.description: List published CanonicAI answer summaries from the static Answers corpus. Returns slug, id, question, canonical URLs, and citation counts.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Return one Answer contract v0 record with citations for a known slug. Never fabricates content for unknown slugs.

tools.name: search_answers
tools.description: Search CanonicAI answers by simple deterministic token scoring over question, shortAnswer, and answer fields.

tools.name: list_canons
tools.description: List published CanonicAI domain canons from the static canon bundle. Returns slug, action statement, construct/source counts, and canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_canon
tools.description: Return one canon-v1 record (constructs, relationships, open divergences, provenance, source works) for a known slug. Never fabricates content for unknown slugs; returns close-match slugs instead.

tools.name: search_constructs
tools.description: Search construct names and definitions across all canons (or one canon) by deterministic token scoring.
